stem: A 13-year-old girl is being investigated for delayed puberty; which sex steroid should be measured alongside FSH and LH in the initial blood tests?
explanation: Oestradiol is the correct sex steroid to measure alongside FSH and LH in the initial assessment of delayed puberty in a girl.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Delayed Puberty

rationale: This question asks for the sex steroid paired with FSH and LH in the initial blood tests for delayed puberty. In a girl, that hormone is oestradiol.

optionExplanations.A: Correct because oestradiol is the relevant sex steroid measured alongside FSH and LH in a girl with delayed puberty.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because testosterone is the male sex steroid and is not the appropriate paired hormone in this girl.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because DHEAS is not the sex steroid paired with FSH and LH for the initial delayed-puberty blood tests.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because insulin is not part of the sex steroid assessment for delayed puberty.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because cortisol is not the sex steroid measured with FSH and LH in this context.
